note: Names that are present but convey nothing. A screen reader announcing these is no better off than silence, so they are treated as violations rather than as fixes.
source: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y img-redundant-alt, and the WebAIM alt-text guidance on redundant and placeholder text.
by_tag_note: Noise that is noise only for one element. 'Continue' names a button honestly and 'more' does not name a link, so link-text noise cannot live in the global list without refusing correct button labels. Phrases verified against the ambiguous-link-text list in Community-Access/accessibility-agents (action/scan.mjs, MIT).
